summary: Iteration 2 (Addresses + Variations/Addons + Loyalty) tested end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 new-feature pytest tests pass (address lifecycle incl. default toggle & delete, seeded X-Burger variations/addons, lojista product create with variations, order unit_price 36.90 for X-Burger+Duplo+Bacon, /loyalty endpoint, redeem 20 pts deducts + earn floor(total) on FINALIZADO + NO double credit on re-finalize, refund on CANCELADO, order address snapshot). Regression: 25/27 pass; 2 pre-existing test bugs unrelated to iter2 (email lowercase in register test, lojista active_role mutated to 'cliente' from earlier UI/manual runs). Frontend (390x844): full flow verified — sign-in cliente → /addresses add TEST_UI (form validated) → store detail Burger House → tap X-Burger Clássico opens ProductCustomizer modal → select Duplo/Ao ponto/Bacon extra with live price R$ 36,90 → Adicionar → cart CTA → checkout shows options label, two-address selector (Casa default), Pix, and loyalty card 'Usar 226 pontos • desconto R$ 22,60' → toggle points → total drops 43,80→21,20 → Confirmar → redirected to /track/{id} showing item options and 'Pontos (226) - R$ 22,60' and total R$ 21,20. No red screens, no blocking errors.

issues: Delivery fee is hardcoded to 6.9 in checkout (line 32) instead of pulled from selected store's delivery_fee. Backend uses actual store fee, so displayed total on checkout can differ from server total when store fee != 6.9 (Pizzaria Bella=8.00, Açaí Tropical=5.00). Confirm button shows a preview total that may not match final.

Console warning: 'No route named cart exists in nested children'. A `<Stack.Screen name=cart>` (or similar) is declared without a matching /app/(customer)/cart.tsx. Remove the declaration or add the file.
Persistent deprecated 'shadow*' style props warning (pre-existing from iter1).

action_items: checkout.tsx: replace hardcoded `deliveryFee = 6.9` with the delivery_fee from the current store (cart already knows storeId — fetch or store fee in cart context) so preview total matches server total for Pizzaria/Açaí.
(customer)/_layout.tsx: remove the orphan `cart` Stack.Screen reference (or create the screen) to eliminate console warning.
backend_test.py: (minor) update test_register_new_cliente to compare lowercase email and reset lojista active_role at fixture start so regression suite stays green.
critical_code_review_comments: Order create redemption logic caps redemption to (subtotal+delivery-discount) which is correct; frontend also caps via maxRedeemablePoints. Consistent.
double-credit guard `not order.get('points_credited')` verified working — repeating FINALIZADO does NOT credit twice.
Address `is_default` behavior: first address auto-default; POST with is_default=True correctly unsets others via update_many. Verified.
Product variations schema flows through /my/products create + /orders create option_labels snapshot cleanly; unit_price rounded to 2dp.

success_rate.backend: 100% (9/9 iter2 tests; 25/27 total when including iter1 regression, 2 failures are pre-existing test-code issues)

seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seed unchanged; tests create/delete TEST_ addresses and TEST_Combo products with cleanup.
